quest.title: Adventurers of Teyvat: Grand Showdown!
quest.description: While heading to the Snezhnaya Adventurers' Guild headquarters, you and Paimon are stopped in your tracks by two "S-Rank" adventurers...

talks.objective: Go to the Adventurers' Guild headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? That person up ahead looks kind of familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold on. Isn't she Lan, the Master of the Liyue branch!?

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: So you really came all the way to the headquarters counter after all?

choices.text: I don't owe anyone money in Snezhnaya, do I?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Oh, we're not trying to corner you. We've known each other long enough, haven't we? There's no grudge between us.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Besides, if we really tried to take you on with what little strength we have, we'd be swept aside before you even got serious.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Please forgive us. We merely wished to keep you from vanishing without warning again.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: If we let you leave now, there's no telling when we'd have another chance to see you.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Please, allow me, Talalikhin, clerk of the Snezhnayan Adventurers' Guild headquarters, to make the matter clear.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: #You, {NICKNAME}, are one of only fifteen S-rank adventurers — with a reputation that has long since outgrown a single page.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: And there is a tournament of great importance waiting for you. Without your return, it remains unfinished.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aah—! Paimon nearly jumped out of her skin! She thought this was about to turn into a fight in the middle of town...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's only a tournament, right? Then just say that! Did you think we'd turn you down?

choices.text: Maybe. Depends on whether you make it worth our while.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey!

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Naturally. The Mora, supplies, and other compensation have all been arranged to a standard worthy of the two of you.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: We have also prepared a buffet in your honor, featuring signature dishes from establishments you have visited throughout the nations.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: And should the menu fall short of Guide Paimon's expectations, the chefs stand ready to prepare whatever she requests.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? No limit on how much Paimon can eat?

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: I admit, it must look as though I have been keeping a careful file on you. Your caution is perfectly reasonable.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: But please be at ease. In truth, your name carries much farther through the Adventurers' Guild than you realize.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Long story short, you two cleared commissions that would've kept hundreds of adventurers busy for hundreds of lifetimes. So yes, the whole trade has its eyes on you now...

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: The sharp ones have already started treating your way of doing things like a ready-made walkthrough. Some are even planning to write a book breaking down your every move.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: All those accounts make their way in from across Teyvat and end up at headquarters in Snezhnaya. Talalikhin's the one stuck sorting through them — and by now, he can probably recite the whole thing in his sleep.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: And that's exactly why, at a tournament where the strongest adventurers gather, it's only natural for opinions to clash. None of them made it that far by backing down easily.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: #When that happens, {NICKNAME} is the only one who can break the deadlock and settle the important calls.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh... So basically, {NICKNAME} has become indispensable to the Guild!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, yep! About time they realized it!

choices.text: Got it. So, what's the actual matter at hand?

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Let us proceed to the venue without delay. Once we arrive, I will go over the details with you.

choices.text: Then, tell us how the competition works.
You know an awful lot about our travels?
If the reward's not good enough, it's not making it onto my schedule.
I haven't made any enemies here, have I?

dialogues.speaker: Talalikhin
dialogues.text: As you can see, this is the competition venue.

dialogues.speaker: Talalikhin
dialogues.text: To be precise, this is the venue for the Adventurers' Guild Development Conference.

dialogues.speaker: Talalikhin
dialogues.text: The original purpose of inviting adventurers from every nation was to discuss the future direction of the Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Talalikhin
dialogues.text: However, the discussions have since reached a standstill. With no side willing to give ground, the competition was moved ahead of schedule...

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: The First Adventurers' Tournament was meant to be a friendly gathering for adventurers from every nation. But now, it's turned into a contest for influence.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Every national branch sent a team, and every team is led by the strongest adventurer they could get their hands on at short notice.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Liyue's got me. Mondstadt's captain is Iris, an old camping buddy from trips through snowy mountains and along the coast. Great in a fight. Hopeless at drinking.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Then there's Inazuma's "Workaholic Warrior," Rika... We haven't crossed paths much, but she knows her manners. Good enough in my book.

dialogues.speaker: Talalikhin
dialogues.text: Sumeru's main representative is Lemta, the legendary mercenary. After she spent three and a half years looking after a rookie, most people assumed she was stepping back from the field.

dialogues.speaker: Talalikhin
dialogues.text: Fontaine's captain is a rising talent who works alongside Nadia and Urville, with exceptional planning skills and execution.

dialogues.speaker: Talalikhin
dialogues.text: Natlan is represented by Liliuo, the "Frost Star of Ixquimilli" — a famed tribal warrior whose recent achievements have risen at a remarkable pace.

dialogues.speaker: Talalikhin
dialogues.text: As for Nod-Krai, Sarin is a promising young talent and a well-rounded competitor. He is highly skilled at managing relations among various factions, and has completed numerous exceptionally difficult commissions...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's getting dizzy just listening to all these names... While we were off doing our thing, the adventuring world was busy turning out all kinds of big shots, huh?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: #{NICKNAME}'s only got one thing to do. Knock every opponent flat... me included.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Ahem, in proper terms, that means taking first place in all four main skill challenges...

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: "Trigger Reflex Trial" will put your mastery of the new musket front and center.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: "Maze of Frost and Foresight" is your chance to show the next generation how seasoned adventurers think on their feet when navigating Domains.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: "Roly-Poly Domain Raid" is where you can let your strength do the talking. Get a read on the Domain's quirks, then throw yourself into the fight and have at it.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: And with the new "Precision Express Handling," we'll see how well you can keep things moving while staying in control — the mark of an adventurer who can manage every part of the operation at once.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: All four challenges have been newly devised, leaving every team without a map to follow. They will need to adapt as the situation unfolds, and prove their worth through action alone.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: Once you achieve a score beyond comparison, many of the issues raised at this conference will be settled by your judgment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come to think of it, don't you and Talalikhin have any requests of your own, Lan?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Do I seem like the type to sit around debating whether adventurers need a clock-in policy?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: I already got the Liyue Branch more funding and better prizes. As for the remaining issues, I'm fine with whatever they decide.

response.speaker: Talalikhin
response.text: For my part, as the representative from headquarters, I simply hope we can arrive at a resolution that earns everyone's confidence, and bring this conference to a successful close.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Paimon gets it now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's see, let's see...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This might sound a little rude, but the Paimon Power Detector has finished scanning.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, they're definitely strong adventurers, and they deserve every bit of recognition. No wonder they could put up such a good fight.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #But {NICKNAME}? {NICKNAME} is only S-rank because nobody bothered to invent a higher one!

choices.text: Now that's the kind of assessment I can get behind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, once you sign up, Paimon can already see where this is headed!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, this is a contest no one's ever tried before. It sounds fun, the rewards are worth chasing, and we get to help the Adventurers' Guild while we're at it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So let's set the tone from the very start!

choices.text: Let's keep our feet on the ground. You never know when a hidden master might step forward...
There are plenty we haven't met.
